contract: Cut an aligned stream into syncframes and inspect each with the manifest's BSI-bit and frame-byte limits. Preserve the public parser's documented refusals and the exact physical and effective fields.

Fold kind 1 with frame offset and byte length. Fold kind 3 with field index and presence, followed by a scalar and zero or a range start and bit count. Use Eac3BsiFacts order, Eac3Trailer order, then channel-map channel count and count consistency. Fold kind 2 with the length and exact source bytes covering the additional BSI range when present.
Fold kind 7 with the accepted frame count at clean end, or kind 8 with the source offset of the first refused frame.

open_unmeasured.cause: The reference has no public view of all E-AC-3 BSI fields and bit ranges
